name: Haven Craft Kitchen+Bar
tagline: Seasonal farm-to-table cuisine, elevated burgers, and exceptional craft brews
description: An anchor of Old Towne Orange dining culture for over 15 years, Haven elevates neighborhood gastropub fare with organic produce from local farms, a renowned proprietary beef grind for burgers, house-made charcuterie, and an award-winning cellar of rotating craft beers and natural wines.
historicNote: Housed within a turn-of-the-century mercantile building steps from The Plaza, showcasing restored original brick walls and vintage amber Edison lighting.

specials.title: Neighborhood Industry Night
specials.description: 20% off all draft beers, house cocktails, and signature flatbreads for locals and restaurant industry friends.

specials.title: Elevated Taco & Mezcal Tuesday
specials.description: Chef-crafted braised pork belly and grilled baja rockfish tacos ($6 each) with $10 Oaxacan mezcal margaritas.

specials.title: Cellar Wine Wednesday
specials.description: Half-off all bottles of sommelier-selected biodynamic and California boutique wines with purchase of an entree.

specials.title: Haven Burger & Craft Pint Combo
specials.description: The famous Haven Burger (proprietary beef blend, wild arugula, roasted red pepper jam, Saint Agur blue) + choice craft draft for $21.

specials.title: Sunset Patio Happy Hour
specials.description: $8 craft cocktails, $6 rotating tap handles, $9 duck fat fries, and $10 crispy brussels sprouts.

specials.title: Weekend Garden Brunch
specials.description: Brioche French Toast, Haven Benedict, House Pork Hash, and $12 bottomless seasonal mimosas.

specials.title: Sunday Roast & Acoustic Hour
specials.description: Slow-braised beef short ribs dinner special ($28) accompanied by chilled regional IPA flights.

events.title: Monthly Brewer Spotlight & Tap Takeover
events.description: Featuring 6 rare specialty casks from top West Coast breweries, paired with a custom 3-course tasting menu from Executive Chef.

researchMetadata.verificationNotes: Verified seasonal gastropub menu, Taco Tuesday, Cellar Wine Wednesday, and Sunday Roast.
